mapLocation.label: Talk to Thormac at the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower, south-east of the Ranging Guild.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy from Velrak the explorer for 0 gp.
itemsRequired.note: Dusty key (obtainable during the quest) or .

route.title: Getting started
steps: Talk to Thormac on the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower south of Seers' Village. Dialogue: "What do you need assistance with?", "So how would I go about catching them then?", "Ok, I will do it then" ()

Go to Seers Village and speak to a Seer. (Wait until the seer is done checking himself in the mirror.) Dialogue: "Your friend Thormac sent me to speak to you." Be sure not to skip this step, as the scorpion in Taverley Dungeon is not accessible without first speaking to the seer.
Scorpions can be caught in any order and there is no need to return between each catch.

route.title: First scorpion
steps: Note: You will need a dusty key if you don't have 70 Agility, make sure to grab it before entering the dungeon.
Go into Taverley Dungeon, (South Taverley) and go to the poison spider area.
Directly south of the level 80 Agility shortcut, search the old wall to enter a small room.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.

route.title: Second scorpion
steps: Go to the Barbarian Outpost (a games necklace is helpful).
Go inside the fenced in area near the entrance to the agility course.
Go inside the building in the north-east corner of the area.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.

route.title: Third scorpion
steps: Go to the Monastery between Edgeville and Ice Mountain (a combat bracelet will take you right there).
Climb the eastern ladder and go to the east side of the floor.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.

route.title: Finishing Up
steps: Return the full scorpion cage to Thormac.
